scheme_name: Tripura Health Assurance Scheme For Poor
other_conditions: Coverage is available for up to five family members.
Eligible family members include the policyholder's legal spouse, parents, and unmarried children up to 25 years of age.
All family members must be listed on the family ration card issued by the Government of Tripura.
benefits_summary: Health cover of up to Rs 1.15 lakh per family per year, with an additional transportation allowance of Rs 10,000.
